title: Chapter 2919 - 165: The Mystery of the Holy Beast (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 2919: Chapter 165: The Mystery of the Holy Beast (Part 2)

And this white bloodline also caused a slight tremor in Mo Hua’s heart.

In his Sea of Consciousness, the Divine Thought Body on his forehead, the breath of the Pi Xiu horn seemed to echo with this breath from afar.

"This is... the breath of the Holy Beast of the Great Wilderness..."

Mo Hua’s pupils shrank.

In a flash of enlightenment, he suddenly understood why those Tiger Demons outside went mad trying to rush in when the Big Tiger was breaking through.

What they sought was this strand of "Holy Beast" bloodline.

These Tiger Demons... they wanted to steal the bloodline.

They wanted to become "holy"!

Mo Hua furrowed his brows, finally understanding.

Why those tigresses were so focused on the Big Tiger "Da Hua".

It’s not because the Big Tiger is "heartless", nor only because the Great Wilderness has gone to war with the Taoist Court, with few male tigers.

The main reason is the bloodline on the Big Tiger.

Although only a small strand, not overwhelming, but this pure white, sacred, glowing, exuding purity from flesh without contamination, cleansing foulness without monstrosity, breath is obviously the ancient Great White Tiger of the Wilderness’s "Holy Beast" bloodline.

No wonder these tigresses would gather around Da Hua.

No wonder they would go mad for it now.

And the reason the Big Tiger has suppressed its breakthrough for so long must be because of the bloodline’s instinct, sensing the danger of being "stolen", thus delaying the breakthrough for self-preservation.

At the same time, it is also waiting for me.

I am its lifesaver from childhood, having lived through life and death, its only trusted "companion" since youth.

The Big Tiger does not trust humans, does not trust its kind, does not trust any other Monster Beasts, but only trusts me.

If I had not returned, if I had not stayed by its side, the Big Tiger might never have broken through, even in death.

Mo Hua felt somewhat complicated and slowly breathed a sigh of relief.

Fortunately, I made it back...

Mo Hua tapped his fingers, adding several Formation seals at the cave entrance, and then sat cross-legged on the ground to calmly protect the Big Tiger.

Meanwhile, he also observed the changes in the flesh of the Big Tiger during its breakthrough, and the transformation and fusion with that strand of white "Holy Beast" breath.

The flesh changes of Monster Beasts during their breakthrough are quite marvelous.

And on the Big Tiger, that strand of pure white Holy Beast bloodline, like silk threads in its body, connecting various flesh and blood meridians, merging them in an "Divine Craftsmanship" like heavenly creation, the construction of bloodlines, truly opened Mo Hua’s eyes...

But while watching, Mo Hua suddenly froze.

He is a Formation Master, used to learning Formation daily, and at this moment, staring at that pure white Holy Beast bloodline, after looking for a long time, his eyes blurred, unconsciously feeling that this bloodline... seems like...

Formation Patterns?!

This scene before him, as if... someone is using a brush to outline a white Formation Pattern, stitching together all the Monster Beasts’ meridians, bones, flesh inside the Big Tiger, ultimately fusing and transforming into, a new "Monster Beast"...

In that moment, Mo Hua felt his scalp suddenly explode.

Is this... artificial "flesh"?!

Using Formation to create Monster Beasts?!

This is not creating a puppet, not making an artifact, not refining a corpse... but using Formation to "construct" a whole new, lifelike flesh and blood life?

Using Formation to create "life"?

And this new Monster Beast, containing sacred breath, can also be called...

Holy Beast?!

So...

The Holy Beasts of the Great Wilderness are actually some kind of... "synthetic beasts"?!

Mo Hua felt a chill down his spine, his scalp tingled, a strong, unprecedented Formation "rule" enough to overturn his understanding, impacting his Sea of Consciousness, creating an unspeakable shock within him.

Formation... creates flesh and blood life.

The Great Wilderness Holy Beast... is a synthetic beast.

This realization constantly impacted Mo Hua’s previously "fixed" Formation concepts, filling him with a sense of incredulity.

Moreover, when Mo Hua thought about it seriously, he found that these two "judgments", given his knowledge of Formation, could indeed be established.

The Dao births all things.

Formation is the most direct reflection of Dao Laws.

Thus, in other words, the Dao births all things, so naturally, Formation can also birth all things, and even... create flesh and blood life.

And on another point...

The Dragon Formation of the Great Wilderness was originally using Taotie Law, deriving essence from various Monster Patterns, piecing them together to form the Four Symbols Sacred Beast Formation.

Holy Beast Formation can be pieced together, can be fused.

Then why can’t the flesh and blood of Holy Beasts?

Can piece together Formation... so naturally, can fuse flesh and blood?

...

Mo Hua took a deep, cold breath.

This knowledge, at the logical level of "Dao" and "Formation", indeed makes sense.

In fact, many clues, many traces, have always existed within his knowledge.

He simply hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, so he never dared, nor had the imagination, to think in that direction...

Mo Hua never imagined that such Formation mysteries, even seeming somewhat "heretical" in his understanding, would truly exist...

Moreover, now, vividly presented before him...

Mo Hua couldn’t help but look again at the Big Tiger lying on the ground.

Blood Qi visualized, black and white intertwined, the Big Tiger was breaking through, condensing its Demon Core, transforming its bloodline.
